caption:
They sold the breakdown. Now they're TRAPPED. 🪤

Aggressive sellers hit the bid at the low: 3 stacked sell imbalances on the footprint. But price can't follow through and closes back above support. Those shorts are now underwater, and their buy stops above the breakdown bar become the fuel for the squeeze.

1️⃣ Stacked sell imbalances at the low
2️⃣ No follow-through = trap
3️⃣ Act on the reclaim, invalidate below the trap low
